name: Don't Get Too Close
source:
Don't Get Too Close is a short visual novel about slowly accepting change. Without spoiling too much, this game covers 2 lives as they continue side by side.

[From [url=https://thetadog.itch.io/dont-get-too-close]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《别走得太近》是一部关于慢慢接受改变的短篇视觉小说。在不剧透太多的情况下，这款游戏涵盖了2条生命，他们并肩前进。

[来自[url=https://thetadog.itch.io/dont-get-too-close]Itch.io[/url]]
